description: Returns errors and warnings from the language server for a single file, plus narrow code slices around each diagnostic. Use this BEFORE calling optimized_read_file when the agent is trying to fix an error — it returns ~10 lines of context around each issue instead of the whole file. Detected frameworks: none

contextLines.description: Lines of context around each diagnostic (default 10)

path.description: Path to the file, relative to project root

name: optimized_diagnostics
title: Get LSP diagnostics for a file (token-optimized)
